prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Find and grab object. Move, take, and check properties. Perform specific task if light. Otherwise, scan.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <SubTree ID = PerformSpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectWeightLight    /> <Action ID = MoveToNextLocation    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />     <Sequence>         <Condition ID = IsObjectWithinReach    />         <Action ID = GrabObject    />         <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />     </Sequence>     <Action ID = MoveToNextLocation    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectWeightLight? THEN
				DO MoveToDestination
		ELSE
			DO PerformSpecificTask
		END
	END
